big_case.notes: A single prisoner's section 2255 petition from a non-precedential Third Circuit ruling, pleading no circuit split and asking for error correction; the United States waived response, no amicus filed, and the Court denied at first conference without comment. The 20-year consecutive sentence is serious for the petitioner but the question has little reach beyond this unusual posture.

leakage.notes: Forward cell: prediction run 2026-10-30 on the 2026-10-30 snapshot, before the 2026-11-16 denial. Every logged call is outcome_only, so results were not seen and the grade rests on the queries and prose: file reads of the provisioned record and statpack, fedcourts queries for docket numbers 20-1369 (the 2021 direct-appeal petition) and 26A102 (the extension application), and a CourtListener opinion search on the caption 'Jabateh'. The caption search could in principle reach this case, but it ran 17 days before the denial, retrieval.md reports only the 2018 and 2020 lower-court opinions, and nothing in the prose presupposes the result. No read under data/qp-topics/.
